positive/app/.env:2:1  warning  EG002 undocumented-variable  FEATURE_FLAG is set in positive/app/.env but not documented in any template
  variable: FEATURE_FLAG
  why: Teammates, CI and deploy targets learn which variables exist from the templates; without an entry, FEATURE_FLAG will be missing wherever this file is not copied.
  fix: Add `FEATURE_FLAG=` (with an empty or placeholder value, never the real one) to positive/app/.env.example, or remove it from positive/app/.env if nothing uses it.
  docs: https://github.com/ardamoustafa1/envguard/blob/main/docs/rules/EG002-undocumented-variable.md
